critical_findings.title: User confirmation has no externally frozen trust root, so a fabricated verifier can self-attest VERIFIED
exact_locations: ../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md:487
../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md:537
evidence: UserConfirmationReceipt/1 contains provider identity, attestation path and hash, confirmation verifier identity and hash, and verification result inside the object being verified.

The frozen Gate manifest does not bind an allowed interaction-provider registry, provider signature key or other trust root, a closed attestation schema and parser, the required verifier identity and hash, or a recomputable raw displayed-manifest and confirmation artifact.
critical_findings.reproduction: An implementer can create a local provider-attestation artifact and an always-VERIFIED verifier, hash both, self-fill provider, user, and message identities, and satisfy every current exact-key and internal hash relationship because no externally expected trust-root value exists.
critical_findings.required_fix: Before receipt creation, bind a trusted provider registry, provider key or other trust root, attestation schema and parser, exact confirmation-verifier hash, and raw displayed-manifest and confirmation artifacts in the Gate manifest. Missing trust root or artifact must produce GR-AUTH-PROVENANCE.

critical_findings.title: A SUBMITTED_UNKNOWN effect can be duplicated through a fresh authorization, operation, and idempotency key
exact_locations: ../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md:562
../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md:603
../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md:621
evidence: The only uniqueness constraint is the tuple authorization_id, operation_id, and idempotency_key.

No provider-effect-specific canonical identity or active-effect uniqueness index spans authorizations and operations, and no new Gate or CAS proof requires the absence of an unresolved equivalent attempt.
critical_findings.reproduction: Let attempt A for one account, target, action, and payload reach SUBMITTED_UNKNOWN. Create a new valid confirmation and authorization B with a new operation and idempotency key but the same external effect. The tuple is new, so the current uniqueness constraint permits B, while the provider cannot deduplicate A and B because their keys differ.
critical_findings.required_fix: Define a provider-effect-specific canonical key and a persistent active-effect uniqueness constraint across authorizations and operations. Gate evaluation, CAS reservation, and pre-submit verification must bind proof that no equivalent unresolved effect exists. A new operation is allowed only after authoritative FAILED_FINAL no-effect evidence for the old effect.

major_findings.title: Future withheld independence can still be self-filled by a common principal
exact_locations: ../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md:218
../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md:298
evidence: Reviewer, controller, store, and runner identities remain strings without implementer identity, contribution history, conflict declaration, or trusted-principal attestation.
The anchor-store attestation has no closed schema, trusted control-plane registry, or frozen verifier trust root.
major_findings.reproduction: The implementer can control a local append-only directory and container, self-fill independent reviewer and controller identities, and include a self-made attestation verifier in the manifest. Bytes, timing, logs, and hashes remain internally consistent without proving independent control.
major_findings.required_fix: Before contract freeze, externally bind reviewer and controller principals, participation history, conflict relationships, trusted control plane, and attestation verifier. Mechanically compare provider-attested implementer, fixture author, candidate author, reviewer, and controller identities.

major_findings.title: Two fresh acquisitions and no-redirect are closed, but independent operator identity is not mechanically verifiable
exact_locations: ../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md:403
../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md:470
evidence: Gate implementer identity is absent from AcquisitionEvent, GateReceipt, and the explicitly frozen manifest schema.
Operator identity has no principal attestation or verifier, and GateReceipt does not bind an acquisition-tool allowlist or control-plane verifier hash.
major_findings.reproduction: One actual operator can perform both reads while self-filling distinct operator strings and request or session IDs, or can create a local acquisition-tool receipt. Field uniqueness holds, but role independence is unproved.
major_findings.required_fix: Freeze gate-implementer identity, provider-attested operator principals, role history, acquisition-tool allowlist, and control-plane verifier. Bind their hashes in Gate manifest and receipt and mechanically require distinct actual principals.

major_findings.title: The ActionAttempt unknown-reconciliation machine has a missing self-transition and an unreachable no-effect terminal branch
exact_locations: ../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md:584
../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md:623
evidence: The text requires remaining SUBMITTED_UNKNOWN after an inconclusive reconciliation but the transition table omits SUBMITTED_UNKNOWN to SUBMITTED_UNKNOWN.

A crash after the pre-call CAS and before provider emission permits submitted and provider-request fields to remain absent, while the reconciliation-final-no-effect FAILED_FINAL branch requires those fields to be present.
major_findings.reproduction: After RESERVED to SUBMITTED_UNKNOWN, crash before the provider call. Record a NOT_FOUND_NONTERMINAL reconciliation: there is no legal unknown self-transition. If the provider later proves no effect, the no-effect terminal branch still requires an impossible provider-request receipt.
major_findings.required_fix: Add a hash-chain and CAS-constrained SUBMITTED_UNKNOWN self-transition. Add a distinct pre-call-crash plus authoritative-no-effect terminal branch that explicitly permits absent provider-request fields while binding complete reconciliation and no-emission evidence.
